title: tc-answer-arena
description: Two to four models' answers to the same prompt side by side, with a vote: which is better (or best), a tie or all bad, and a reason.

answers.description: The answers: A first, then B – two for a head-to-head, three or four to pick the best (more than four are left out)

value.description: The vote (null: none yet). Changed by the element unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

blind.description: Hide the model names until there's a vote

reasons.description: Reasons offered after A or B wins

allGoodReasons.description: Reasons offered after "All equally good", with three or more answers

badReasons.description: Reasons offered after "All bad", with three or more answers

model.description: The model's name – hidden until the vote in blind mode

answer.description: The answer so far – may grow while `streaming` is set

meta.description: A short line under the answer, e.g. "1.8s · 212 tokens"

id.description: What tc-value-change's `winnerId` names when this answer wins – defaults to the model's name

ArenaWinner.description: A side by letter ("a"–"d", in `answers` order), a tie ("tie" – with three or more, "All equally good") or, with three or more, "bad" ("All bad")
